name: 72206 · Little Rock, AR
findings: ZIP 72206 (Little Rock) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72206 (Little Rock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 72206 (Little Rock) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
